Name of Test Case: Browse sermon catalog and open message
Action to Take: Click on sermon card 'The Heart of the Father - Luke 15' in sermon list.
Expected Outcome: Navigates to '#/notes/:id'; loads full sermon transcript, media player, and AI ask panel.

Name of Test Case: Ask AI question about sermon content
Action to Take: In sermon ask box, type 'What did the pastor say about the older brother?' and click Ask.
Expected Outcome: AI queries sermon embeddings, returns answer summarizing pastor's points, and quotes verbatim sentences with timestamps.

Name of Test Case: Click transcript timestamp to seek media player
Action to Take: Click timestamp link '[14:32]' inside sermon transcript text.
Expected Outcome: Audio/video player seeks immediately to 14 minutes 32 seconds and starts playback.

Action to Take: Click 'Bible quotes' button in highlight categories toggle bar.
Expected Outcome: All direct Scripture quotations in transcript highlight with gold background styling.

Name of Test Case: Tap scripture highlight to open YouVersion verse card
Action to Take: Click highlighted Bible reference 'Romans 8:28' in sermon transcript.
Expected Outcome: VerseCard popover opens displaying full text of Romans 8:28 fetched from Bible API.

Name of Test Case: Switch preferred Bible translation in reader preferences
Action to Take: Open reader settings and change translation from NIV to ESV.
Expected Outcome: Passage references reload with English Standard Version text; preference saved to localStorage.

Name of Test Case: Adjust transcript font size for accessibility
Action to Take: Click font size '+' button in reader toolbar.
Expected Outcome: Transcript body text size increases from 16px to 19px for enhanced readability.

Name of Test Case: Staff creates new sermon note via YouTube URL
Action to Take: Sign in as staff, click '+ New note', enter valid YouTube link, title 'Sunday Service', and click 'Create note'.
Expected Outcome: Backend queues YouTube audio download and Whisper transcription job; sermon status becomes 'queued'.

Name of Test Case: Process sermon video with bot-protected YouTube URL
Action to Take: Submit a YouTube sermon URL that requires bot challenge or sign-in verification.
Expected Outcome: System bypasses bot challenge and downloads audio for transcription.

Name of Test Case: Upload video file exceeding 95 MB limit
Action to Take: Attach 120 MB MP4 sermon recording and click 'Create note'.
Expected Outcome: Client-side file validation prevents upload and shows clear file size guidance.
